newsitem.title: USA: Lucent Q3 net triples, blows past consensus.
newsitem.headline: Lucent Q3 net triples, blows past consensus.

text.p: (Unaudited; Millions of dollars, except per share amounts)
NOTES: Q3 network carrier systems business revs up 27.3 pct to $3.8 bln.
Q3 business communications group revs up 16.3 pct to $1.56 bln.
Q3 microelectronics business up 13.6 pct to $687 million.
Q3 consumer products revs decline 29.6 pct to $193 million.
Outstanding shares for the quarter ended June 30, 1997 was computed on a weighted average share basis including common stock equivalents.

The number of outstanding shares for the quarter ended June 30, 1996 was computed on a pro forma basis using the 636.7 million shares that were outstanding after the Initial Public Offering (IPO) of 112.0 million shares in April 1996 and gives no effect to the use of proceeds from the IPO.
Weighted average earnings per share was $0.11 for the quarter ended June 30, 1996 using 625.6 million weighted average shares.
Q3 gross margin 41 pct vs 40.5 pct margin in Q3 1996.
